name: Permits & License Committee Special Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  July 11, 2019

Meeting Place:  Community Room A, 1st Floor

Call to Order:  2:00 p.m.

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the agenda may
do so at this time.

Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Parks and Recreation, City of Inglewood to host Movies in the Park at Edward
  Vincent Park, 700 Warren Lane, on July 13, 2019 from 8:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m.
  (Activity No. 00276044)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Parks and Recreation, City of Inglewood to host Movies in the Park at Inglewood
  City Hall (south lawn area), One Manchester Blvd., on August 10, 2019 from 8:00
  p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00276045)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Parks and Recreation, City of Inglewood to host Movies in the Park at Darby Park,
  3400 W. Arbor Vitae, on August 24, 2019 from 8:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity
  No. 00276046)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Costco Wholesale is seeking to extend the previously approved night construction
  dates for the Costco Fuel Expansion project at 3560 W. Century Blvd.,
  Construction is anticipated to occur this year for approximately 60 days. Nighttime
  construction hours include 8:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
  (Activity No. 00276041)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Adjournment
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE MEETING
  SPECIAL MINUTES
  July 11, 2019

A Special meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, July 11,
2019, at 2:34 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Also present: Teresa Estrada-Quintanar, Superintendent.

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Parks and Recreation, City of Inglewood to host Movies in the Park at
  Edward Vincent Park, 700 Warren Lane, on July 13, 2019 from 8:00 p.m.
  – 10:00 p.m.; Parks and Recreation, City of Inglewood to host Movies in
  the Park at Inglewood City Hall (south lawn area), One Manchester Blvd.,
  on August 10, 2019 from 8:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m.; Inglewood Police
  Department (IPD) shell staff 1 Sgt., 2 Officers and 1 Patrol Car from 5pm-
  11pm; Parks & Recreation staff shall identify and make available employee
  as contact as responsible, which will be available by cell phone to IPD; park
  staff shall wear an Inglewood City Parks and Rec. identifying shirt;
  evacuation/exit plan shall be briefed to crowd prior to event; should the
  movie stop for unknown reason, park staff shall be available to fix any
  issues; a loudspeaker/microphone shall be made available for public safety
  announcements and instruction; no smoking of tobacco products including
  vapes; no smoking or consumption of any cannabis or cannabis products
  and or drugs; No possession of any weapons or items considered to be
  weapons by IPD; No alcoholic beverages allowed in the park; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously.  (Activity No.
  00276044)

Item #4:  Costco Wholesale is seeking to extend the previously approved night

  Century Blvd., Construction is anticipated to occur this year for
  approximately 60 days. Nighttime construction hours include 8:00 p.m. to
  7:00 a.m. Monday through Sunday: subject to staffing of 1 uniformed
  security guard during day, 2 uniformed security guards at night: responsible
  party contact number forwarded to WC for noise complaint mitigation;
